video_title: Melo QUESTIONS Doc Rivers' Giannis Comments & Reveals How Coaches Lose the Locker Room

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Why coaches blame players instead of their own coaching failures
quotes.excerpt: Why does it feel like some coaches are quicker to blame the players than look at what

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Why does it feel like some coaches are quicker to blame the players than look at what they could have done differently to help those guys win? Giannis Antetokounmpo seemed to be very hurt by the comments that Doc Rivers made.

text_blocks.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
text_blocks.text: You really have to break that down into a couple pieces. That is Giannis' game. It is relentless, it is going at you, it is non-stop, it is physical, it is forceful. There is no finesse to his game, but that is not a shot at him. As a former player, it is always easy for the player to get the blame because it is an easy target. No player is going to win in a player-coach situation.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of communication between a coach and a star player
quotes.excerpt: To me, that communication is key. You coach me. You have been in the bunker with me.
quotes.quote: To me, that communication is key. You coach me. You have been in the bunker with me. You know what I had to go through with injuries and trying to win and what we had to prepare and you know where I am at. So to pinpoint just that part of his game, he is not saying nothing wrong, but it is just why? What is the point of saying that as far as the execution part of it?

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The difficulty of playing a specific style alongside Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: It is very difficult to be out there with Giannis. You have to be a certain type of player.
quotes.quote: It is very difficult to be out there with Giannis. You have to be a certain type of player to be on the court with Giannis. That is not a secret. If you watch basketball, you can make that assessment.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: Doc Rivers' history of blowing leads and coaching struggles
quotes.excerpt: You have been the coach of lots of teams that have blown 3-1 leads, got swept.
quotes.quote: The Heat haven't gotten off to the best start. Erik Spoelstra is a great coach, and you have been the coach of lots of teams that have blown 3-1 leads, got swept. You should be the last one talking about somebody's IQ.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: How a lack of buy-in leads to losing the locker room
quotes.excerpt: It starts when people aren't completely bought in to what the message is.
quotes.quote: It starts when people aren't completely bought in to what the message is. I really feel like that stems from a coach not being certain in what he wants and what his vision is. If you are not certain, how is the player going to be certain in what you are trying to tell us to do? So it starts a lot of clicks in a locker room and people get to talking and get to chatting and not believing in the game plan and not believing in the coach and the team's identity.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: The signs of a coach losing the locker room
quotes.excerpt: You feel it before anybody else can see it. The attention to details is not there.
quotes.quote: You feel it before anybody else can see it. The attention to details is not there. Film session is quiet. There is no noise in the film session. Nobody is in the timeouts paying attention. It is all of these things that are just a snowball effect. And the minute you lose that locker room, there is close to almost 100% of the guys that just completely lose it. Nobody is successful in losing the locker room and coming back.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Why coaches lose the locker room due to ego and lack of connection
quotes.excerpt: If you lose a locker room, it is because of certain reasons. It is because of ego.
quotes.quote: If you lose a locker room, it is because of certain reasons. It is because of ego. It is because of vision. It is because of no connection. Whatever it is, there is so many reasons that you could lose that locker room. You might not like the team, and that comes off. You might not like some of the players, and that comes off. That energy comes off, no matter if you try to hide it. So once you lose that, it is gone. It is gone forever.
